mapper.select: SELECT region_id, region_name FROM region ORDER BY region_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `groups` g JOIN small_group sg ON sg.group_id = g.group_id WHERE g.member_id = #{memberId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `groups` ( region_id, member_id, group_name, description, max_members, created_at ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{memberId}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{maxMembers}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() )
INSERT INTO small_group ( group_id, like_category, meet_date, location ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{likeCategory}, #{meetDate}, #{location} )
INSERT INTO group_member ( member_id, group_id, member_role, membership_status, joined_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{groupId}, 'OWNER', 'APPROVED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() )
mapper.select: SELECT sg.small_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, g.max_members, sg.like_category, sg.meet_date, sg.location FROM small_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id WHERE g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, sg.small_group_id DESC
